name: Commander of the Last All-Girl Monster Squad
source:
You arrive at Fort Hollow expecting depot duty and inherit three soldiers nobody expects to survive. You win their trust with hot meals, working weapons, and plans that bring everyone home. When command makes your squad bait, you turn its abandoned supplies into the coast's last chance.

[From [url=https://pomomi.com/series/commander-of-the-last-all-girl-monster-squad]the official website[/url]]
